subject: Procurement path options + readiness check
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@atlaspay.com>; Aisha Gomez <aisha.gomez@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement path options + readiness check

Hi Sam / Aisha —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and three options we discussed so you can pick the path that matches your procurement process: 

TL;DR: We can support card, PO (Net 30/60), or a marketplace purchase via CloudMarket. Each has slightly different timelines for procurement & billing.

Recap of the call:
- Use case: fraud-detection scoring on payment flows, 150–200 reqs/sec peak, expect 12M tokens/month
- Technical: prefer hosted inference initially, may move to Dedicated in Q4 for throughput stability
- Compliance: interested in SOC2 evidence; asked about data retention and KMS integration

Commercial paths (pick one):
1) Card (fastest): Sign order form + card on file. Provisioning within 48 hours.
2) Purchase Order (PO): Standard SOW + order form, Net 30 (or Net 60 if requested); procurement approval needed — typical 7–21 day cycle depending on internal reviews.
3) Marketplace: Buy via CloudMarket listing (if you want to consolidate under your cloud contract); sometimes faster for ops but requires marketplace registration and can add a 7–10 day vendor enrollment step.

Requested next steps from our side:
- I can send a draft quote + order form (PDF) and a short SOC2 summary (1–2 pages).
- If PO: can also provide a redline-friendly contract and a canary test plan.
- If Marketplace: I’ll link the CloudMarket SKU and the marketplace procurement packet.

Can you confirm which commercial path you prefer and whether procurement needs an internal PR number or a specific PO template? If you want PO, please share the contact at procurement and any standard clauses (e.g., insurance limits).

I’m copying Marissa (customer success) so she can line up the onboarding timeline once procurement is cleared.

Thanks —
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[d] +1 (650) 555-0192 | dylan@redwood.com

Attachment: RDW_Quote_AtlasPay_20260321.pdf (quote, draft order form)
Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 type II summary)
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@atlaspay.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Gomez <aisha.gomez@atlaspay.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement path options + readiness check

Thanks Dylan — good recap. A couple quick answers and one request: 

1) Preferred path: PO is our preferred route for anything over $10k ARR. Card is fine for pilots <$10k but procurement prefers PO for production commitments.
2) Timeline: Our procurement SLA is usually 10–14 business days for straightforward orders; with legal redlines it can extend to 3–4 weeks.
3) Docs we need: draft SOW/order form, SOC2 evidence (summary is fine), and a W9 for vendor setup.

Request: Can you send the draft order form as a Word doc (so our legal can redline) and a suggested payment term (Net 30 vs Net 45) you typically accept? Also share a contact in case we need to run the vendor setup form.

We have two internal stakeholders who will be involved: procurement (Aisha) and finance (I'll loop in Priya after initial review).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — if we can get the Word doc + W9 today, I’ll start the procurement intake.

—Sam
Head of Payments Operations
AtlasPay
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>; Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>; Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Thanks Sam — attaching the editable docs.

Action items I completed: 
- Attached: RDW_Quote_AtlasPay_20260321.pdf and RDW_OrderForm_AtlasPay_20260321.docx (editable)
- Attached: RDW_W9.pdf
- SOC2-summary.pdf attached (1 page summary)

Internal notes for team: 
- Marissa: once draft order form is accepted, please prepare onboarding kickoff checklist and a 2-week canary plan for production ramp (150 req/s scope).
- Rishi: please confirm if finance needs a vendor code before we accept PO. If yes, I’ll push for expedited vendor setup.
- Monica: flag any SLA or indemnity items if Aisha’s team redlines (likely insurance limits).

Sam — sending via DocuSign link as well to keep options open for signature.

Best,
Dylan

From: Aisha Gomez <aisha.gomez@atlaspay.com>

Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@atlaspay.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement path options + readiness check

Dylan —

Received the docs, thanks. Procurement reviewed the order form and had three small asks: 
- Please add our standard 60-day invoice payment term option (we lean Net 60 for vendors using our finance partner).
- Add Redwood’s EIN and vendor remit address to the W9 — finance needs the exact remit address block.
- Confirm data residency: we need assurance that production data will reside in us-west-2 (we are not ready for eu/apac).

Priya from finance is copied — she’ll confirm whether we need a vendor code before PO issuance. If vendor code is required, we’ll need the completed vendor setup packet (I’ll share the template).

If you can confirm the residency and add the remit info, I’ll circulate to legal for a 1st pass. Happy to take the DocuSign path if that speeds things up, otherwise we’ll proceed with PO after the vendor setup.

Thanks,
Aisha
Senior Procurement Manager
AtlasPay
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gomez <aisha.gomez@atlaspay.com>; Sam Turner <sam.turner@atlaspay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>; Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>; Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement path options + readiness check

Thanks Aisha — quick status update and next steps (weekly nudge):

Status:
- Residency: Confirmed — production hosted in us-west-2 only (we will not route EU/APAC data for this account).
- W9/Remit: Updated W9 with EIN and remit address attached.
- Payment terms: We can support Net 30 by default; Net 60 is acceptable if AtlasPay covers a 1.5% admin fee on the invoice (we noted this in the editable order form comments). If you prefer, I can add Net 60 as a selectable line item in the order form for faster approval.

Immediate next steps (pick one):
- Option A (fastest): Sign via DocuSign today and we spin up the pilot within 48–72 hours.
- Option B (procure PO): Priya initiates vendor setup; once vendor code is issued we accept PO and target provisioning in ~10 business days.
- Option C (marketplace): I can send CloudMarket SKU and marketplace packet — procurement enrollment usually 7–10 days.

I’ve attached the updated W9 and a one-page onboarding plan for Marissa to run once we have signature/PO. If it helps, I can host a 15-min intake with Priya to walk procurement through the vendor setup fields.

Folks, I’ll follow up again next Monday if I haven’t heard which path you prefer — happy to escalate to our finance ops (Rishi) to help unblock.

Thanks,
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW_W9_updated_20260328.pdf; RDW_OnboardingPlan_1pg.pdf
